descriptionHtml: IEEE WIE Student Branch Affinity Group of the University of Peradeniya organized a special event at Singithi Sevana Children's Home with the aim of brightening the lives of children. The initiative included donating children’s reading books to inspire their imagination and foster a love for learning. The event also featured fun games and activities, bringing joy and laughter to the children. This combination of education and entertainment created a memorable experience, leaving a lasting impact on the children’s lives and reinforcing the importance of community engagement.
